svg.text: Farm Connect — Data Integrity & Transaction Safety Architecture
Mechanisms preventing stock overselling, orphaned records, stale prices, and race conditions across the stack

g.text: 1. ACID TRANSACTIONS (EXECUTETRANSACTION)
The Multi-Step Checkout Hazard
Placing an order requires multiple sequential operations:
1. Decrementing stock_available in products
2. Inserting new row in orders table
Without a transaction: If Step 2 fails, stock drops but no order is created!
Data Hazard
executeTransaction() (backend/src/config/database.js)
Modular backend (order.service.js) guarantees atomic boundary:
const client = await pool.connect();
await client.query('BEGIN'); // Step 1: Start Transaction
const result = await callback(client); // Run all queries
await client.query('COMMIT'); // Step 2: Persist all changes
catch (err) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw err; }
finally { client.release(); } // Guaranteed connection return
Either ALL queries succeed, or ALL queries are completely undone.
ACID Guarantee
Concurrency & Row-Level Locking
• SELECT stock_available FROM products WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE;
• FOR UPDATE locks the specific crop row during checkout
• Prevents race condition where two simultaneous buyers grab the last item
• Database check constraint CHECK (stock_available >= 0) acts as final defense
Row-Level Lock
Connection Pool Isolation
• Each transaction uses exactly ONE dedicated client from the pool
• Separate transactions run on independent client connections in parallel
• READ COMMITTED isolation level default prevents dirty reads
• Zero cross-contamination between concurrent users
Isolated Sessions
2. MULTI-LAYER INTEGRITY SAFEGUARDS
Guard 1: Client-Side Stock Clamping (CartProvider)
When a user repeatedly clicks the '+' button in the UI:
const finalQ = Math.min(newQ, product.stockAvailable);
• Prohibits user from staging 10 units in cart when farmer only has 4
• Disables checkout button if inventory drops to zero while browsing
• Cart immediately syncs to localStorage.farmconnect_cart
src/context/cartcontext.tsx
Guard 2: JSONB Historical Pricing Freeze (orders.items)
Product prices naturally fluctuate according to seasonal harvest supply:
• If farmer raises Tomato price from ₹40 to ₹60 next week,
historical orders must retain the original ₹40 price paid
• Freezing items in JSONB snapshot guarantees immutable ledger
• Historical invoices, tax records, and receipts remain 100% accurate
Immutable Invoice
Guard 3: Single-Use Phone & OTP Idempotency
Authentication security guarantees:
• UNIQUE constraint on farmers.phone and consumers.phone
• otp_store primary key on phone prevents duplicate active OTPs
• Immediate DELETE on successful verification blocks token replay
• 5-minute TTL invalidates expired tokens automatically
Zero Replay Attack
Guard 4: Input Sanitization & Parameterization
Defense against injection and XSS attacks:
• Express middleware sanitizeInputs cleans query & body strings
• Parameterised queries ($1, $2, $3) separate SQL code from user data
• Zod form validation on frontend rejects malformed numbers/emails
• Cloudinary CDN rejects invalid image MIME types during upload
Full-Stack Defense
